newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK-BANKS DOMINATE,NEW INDEX HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK-BANKS DOMINATE,NEW INDEX HIGH.

text.p: Bank stocks dominated trade on
the Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE) this week after Barclays
announced dramatically improved annual results.
The overall index added 10.29 points (+2.8 percent) to an
all time high of 366.18 (355.89).
Barclays shares gained 65 thebe on the week to 525 after
earlier trades in the 470 to 525 range.
Standard Chartered traded up 30 thebe to 420 on the week
with expectations of good results this week. First National,
however, slipped five to 465.
Security group Inco added 15 thebe to 100 thebe on rumours
of an announcement at this week's annual meeting. Oil company
Engen added five thebe to 435 on substantial volume as did
brewery holding company Sechaba, up five to 255.
Untraded were Botswana Insurance at 205/210, investment
company KYS at 170 buyers only, food and tobacco wholesaler
Metsef at 610/625, clothing chain Pep at 255/260, variable loan
stock company RDCP at 165/170 and miller and food wholesaler
Seflana at 420/440.
Turnover on the week was well up with 2,512,450 (453,429)
shares changing hands for a total value of 8,359,945 pula
-- Gaborone newsroom +267 347182
